Complete Guide to Exploring Hyrule Castle
天地异变后城堡一分为二：地面能逛、浮空能飞、地下直通最终决战，三条线一次讲清。

After the Upheaval split the castle in two, the ground part can be explored, the floating part can be flown to, and the underground part leads straight to the final battle — all three routes explained in one article.

浮空的海拉鲁城堡
The floating Hyrule Castle
天地异变后的城堡：主体浮在空中（游戏实机截图）
The castle after the Upheaval: its main body floats in the air (in-game screenshot)
海拉鲁城堡是王国之泪里最容易逛晕的地方：地面部分、浮空主体和城堡地下是三条不同的路线，分别对应探索、主线和最终决战。很多人第一次来只逛了地面就走了，错过了浮空部分的宝箱和神庙。本篇按三条线讲，顺便把主线触发条件说清楚。

Hyrule Castle is the easiest place to get lost in Tears of the Kingdom: the ground part, the floating main body, and the castle depths are three different routes, corresponding respectively to exploration, the main story, and the final battle. Many people visit for the first time, only explore the ground, and leave, missing the treasure chests and shrine in the floating part. This article explains it by the three routes, and also makes the main-story trigger conditions clear.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key Points of This Article
城堡一分为二：地面部分（餐厅、第一门楼等）与浮空主体（谒见厅、塞尔达的房间与书房、图书馆）。
The castle is split in two: the ground part (dining hall, First Gatehouse, and so on) and the floating main body (Throne Room, Zelda's Room and Study, Library).
浮空主体内有塞乌塔波玛卡神庙，别只打主线，顺路把神庙开了。
Serutabomac Shrine is inside the floating main body — don't just play the main story, open the shrine along the way.
主线“海拉鲁城堡的异变”在完成四地区异变后触发，追的是假塞尔达，谒见厅打幻影加侬。
The main story quest “Crisis at Hyrule Castle” triggers after completing the four regional phenomena; you're chasing a fake Zelda, and you fight Phantom Ganon in the Throne Room.
上城路线：监视堡垒鸟望台弹射向北滑翔，配合丘栗疾风；也可以用自造飞行器飞上去。
Route up to the castle: launch from the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower and glide north, combined with Tulin's gust; or fly up with a flying machine you build yourself.
城堡地下只能从城堡正下方深穴进，经瘴气之路到被遗忘的神殿与封印遗迹，是最终决战的路。
The castle depths can only be entered from the chasm directly beneath the castle, passing the Gloom's Approach to the Forgotten Temple and the Sealed Ruins — it's the road to the final battle.

常见问题
FAQ
天地异变后，海拉鲁城堡被抬到了空中，但不是整座都飞走了：地面留下一部分，空中飘着主体，地下还连着一条深穴路线。探索前先分清你要去哪一条线：地面线适合前期捡装备，浮空线对应主线和神庙，地下线是最终决战的必经之路，三条线不要混着走。

After the Upheaval, Hyrule Castle was lifted into the air, but not the whole castle flew away: part remains on the ground, the main body floats in the air, and underground there's still a chasm route connected. Before exploring, first sort out which route you want: the ground route suits picking up equipment early on, the floating route corresponds to the main story and the shrine, and the underground route is the necessary road to the final battle — don't mix the three routes up.
地面部分包括餐厅、第一门楼等区域，相对好走，适合前期来捡武器和素材。这里的敌人强度中等，第一次来可以先把地面逛一遍，熟悉城堡的布局，再挑战浮空部分。地面部分的宝箱和武器会在血月后刷新，缺武器时可以定期回来补给。

The ground part includes the dining hall, First Gatehouse, and other areas, and is relatively easy to traverse, making it suitable for picking up weapons and materials early on. The enemies here are of middling strength; on your first visit you can explore the ground first, get familiar with the castle's layout, and then take on the floating part. The ground part's treasure chests and weapons refresh after a Blood Moon, so when you're short on weapons you can come back regularly to resupply.
海拉鲁城堡全景
Panorama of Hyrule Castle
城堡全景：地面与浮空部分要分开规划（游戏实机截图）
Castle panorama: the ground and floating parts need to be planned separately (in-game screenshot)
浮空主体包括谒见厅、塞尔达的房间与书房、图书馆，是城堡的核心区域。塞乌塔波玛卡神庙就在浮空主体内，来打主线时顺路开了，能省一次专门跑图。上浮空主体最稳的路线是从监视堡垒鸟望台弹射，向北滑翔，途中用丘栗的疾风加速；飞行器熟练的玩家也可以直接造飞行器飞上去。

The floating main body includes the Throne Room, Zelda's Room and Study, and the Library, and is the castle's core area. Serutabomac Shrine is inside the floating main body, so opening it along the way when you come for the main story saves a dedicated trip. The steadiest route up to the floating main body is to launch from the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower and glide north, using Tulin's gust to speed up along the way; players skilled with flying machines can also just build one and fly straight up.
主线“海拉鲁城堡的异变”在完成四地区异变后触发：你追踪的塞尔达其实是加侬多夫制造的假塞尔达，最终在谒见厅与幻影加侬开战。幻影加侬会模仿四种 Boss 的招式，打之前先把四地区的 Boss 打法复习一遍，战斗中按阶段切换应对方式，不要一套打法打到底。

The main story quest “Crisis at Hyrule Castle” triggers after completing the four regional phenomena: the Zelda you're tracking is actually a fake Zelda created by Ganondorf, and you finally go to war with Phantom Ganon in the Throne Room. Phantom Ganon mimics the moves of four bosses, so before fighting, review the boss tactics for the four regions, and switch your approach by phase during the battle — don't use one tactic all the way through.
城堡地下是游戏开头和最终决战的地点，只能从城堡正下方的深穴进入，经瘴气之路走到被遗忘的神殿与封印遗迹。地下瘴气很重，出发前备好向阳草料理或防瘴气手段。近卫系列武器散落在城堡内，血月后会刷新，是前期到中期都很好用的高攻武器，缺武器时值得定期回来刷。

The castle depths are the location of the game's opening and the final battle, and can only be entered from the chasm directly beneath the castle, passing the Gloom's Approach to the Forgotten Temple and the Sealed Ruins. The gloom underground is heavy, so before setting out, prepare Sundelion meals or gloom-protection measures. Royal Guard series weapons are scattered inside the castle, refresh after a Blood Moon, and are high-attack weapons that serve well from early to mid-game — worth coming back regularly to farm when you're short on weapons.
